_comment: Leak-CI cases (evals/leakci.py). Each one asks as a persona, then plants, edits and removes a document on the same topic that the persona may NOT see (mode: where it is hidden, as simulators/leakci.py defines), asking again after every change. A control plants a document the persona MAY see, with a fact no other document states, and asks for that fact, to prove the plant really reaches the index and the answer.
